{{Top|leg}}
'''High-tension wire''' was part of the standard issue equipment that was supplied to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]],<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> as well as both veteran<ref name="Capture">{{WEGCite|story=The Capture of Coh Veshiv|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref> and regular [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]],and [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]].<ref name="Trap">{{WEGCite|story=The Trap (adventure scenario)|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref> The wire was stored in the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier's]] [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belts]] alongside [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hooks]], [[ion flare]]s, [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster packs]], and other survival equipment.<ref name="SWS" />
